topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I remember the day vividly, the sky was an ethereal blue, and the scent of freshly cut grass lingered in the air. We promised to never forget each other, that no matter where life took us, we'd always be there, just a memory away. So when I finally found the courage to reach out after all these years, the silence was almost fitting. It seemed like a cruel twist of fate that the years had erased not just the moments we shared, but the very essence of our bond. I tried to laugh it off, to hide behind a mask of indifference, but the echo of that forgotten past stays with me, a quiet reminder of what once was.
